in_sanskrit.name: Megha
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Relating to or denoting the mass of water vapor suspended in the atmosphere as an aerosol, forming the base of a cloud. The condensation of water vapor into water droplets constitutes cloud formation.

in_marathi.name: Meghal
in_marathi.long_meaning: Meghal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Meghal is derived from the Sanskrit word 'megha', which means 'cloud'. In Hindu mythology, clouds are considered divine and are associated with rain and prosperity.
